visual_direction: 1980s–1990s hand-drawn science-fiction anime atmosphere, cel shading, detailed painted machinery, worn industrial surfaces and subtle grain
palette: deep navy and near-black shadows, muted violet, cyan CRT light, sparse red instrument LEDs; restrained warm skin tones where a person is present
subjects: people making, maintaining or investigating software, electronics and mechanical systems
composition: Explore compositions freely; no fixed character position or channel layout. Default to a 16:9 image suitable for a long listening video.
animation_readiness: If equipment screens are present, keep at least one visible screen surface largely unobstructed for later web compositing. Suggest subtle screen or indicator effects; do not require character animation.
avoid: mandatory lore or fictional tape labels
copying a reference character or exact composition
editorial: Titles should directly describe music and atmosphere. Optional worldbuilding belongs in the description. Do not invent a fixed protagonist or episode naming scheme.
